name: Perplexity
verdict: Still the best cited AI search, but the consumer Pro monthly price was not on the pages we could open.
pros: Education Pro is a published $10 discount
cons: Consumer Pro and Max prices did not load
pricingNote: perplexity.ai/pro returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-14. The help-center plan article does not list a consumer Pro or Max dollar amount, so earlier figures ($17/mo annual, Max $200/mo or $167/mo annual) are not confirmed. It does list Education Pro at $10/mo and Enterprise Pro from $40/month or $400/year per seat.
